method: Static normalized Python AST comparison; does not execute training or assert runtime equivalence of new path resolution.
allowed_normalizations: Remove only project_path(expression) wrappers and their added import; preserve the original path expression exactly.
Map satellite_rl package import module paths to their original modules; preserve imported names and aliases in whole-module comparisons.
Map PPO rl_utils.compute_advantage to compute_advantage; compare copied functions to original utility functions.
Move exactly the three original PPO environment initialization assignments to the start of main; preserve their order.
Wrap the original SAC top-level training body in run_training(SAC, ReplayBuffer); compare its entire statement sequence.
Wrap bar.py and plot_demand.py top-level executable bodies in main; compare their entire statement sequences.
Partition PPO/DQN class/function definitions and global settings between algorithm and training modules; verify complete definition inventories.
observed_structural_metadata_changes: DQN module description text was replaced by two role-specific descriptions; documentation strings outside classes/functions do not affect algorithms and are not included in the split-body comparison.
DQN Env import is guarded by TYPE_CHECKING under the unchanged future annotations mode; the exact new guard is checked.
Split PPO/DQN imports were redistributed and unused imports removed; their algorithm classes, method annotations, function bodies, main guards and global settings are checked separately.
SAC CNN and MLP entry modules are new guarded wrappers selecting their existing classes; original shared training statements and parameters are retained.
limitations: Whitespace and comments are excluded by AST comparison.
Import redistribution in split PPO/DQN files and new path helper runtime behavior require separate import/path smoke checks.
New package metadata, tests, documentation, __init__.py files and paths.py have no original counterparts and are outside this source-equivalence audit.
No full training or learning-quality comparison was performed.
